location.address: Geertebolwerk t.h.v. Zilverstraat a/h water, Utrecht

access: Free, public park (gemeente-owned), open during park hours.
verify_notes: TWO SOURCES: LRMB register nr 1678119 ('Peer', Common Pear) AND independently confirmed via kanokaartutrecht.nl (canal-side monumental-trees route, stop 16, fetched 2026-08-24), which describes it directly: a small, vital old common pear (Pyrus communis) beside the canal at Geertebolwerk near Zilverstraat, still fruiting and flowering white each spring, height 11m, girth 182cm. Gemeente-owned, visitable ja. A modest, minor specimen rather than a giant, and a genuinely unusual story for this site: a fruit tree old enough to be monumental. Real best_time candidate: white blossom in spring, and fruit later in the year. Species basis is a genus placeholder in the register import but the second source confirms Pyrus communis specifically, so this may ship as the confirmed species rather than genus-only.

name: The Field Maple of the Bartholomeibrug
age_estimate: roughly 156 to 166 years, from the register's planting band of 1860-1870

location.address: Zuidkant van de Bartholomeibrug, aan de waterkant, Pelmolenweg, Utrecht

verified_sources: Landelijk Register Monumentale Bomen v2024 (Bomenstichting), entry nr 1688570, data/registers/netherlands-lrmb.json
https://kanokaartutrecht.nl/monumentalebomen.html (independent canal-side monumental-trees guide, cites the same register nr and adds height/girth measurements)
access: Free, public park (gemeente-owned), open during park hours.
verify_notes: TWO SOURCES: LRMB register nr 1688570 ('Veldesdoorn / Spaanse Aak', Field Maple) AND independently confirmed via kanokaartutrecht.nl (canal-side route, stop 18, fetched 2026-08-24), which describes it directly: a field maple with an unusual bent, low growth habit hanging out over the water at the south side of the Bartholomeibrug on the Pelmolenweg. Field maple is the only maple genuinely native to the Netherlands, worth stating plainly. Height 13m, girth 160cm, a small tree; the modest numbers are correctly sanity-checked against the species (field maples rarely reach great size). Register planting band 1860-1870 (roughly 156-166 years); a separate gemeente note ties the general area's planting to the 1835 Zocherpark layout but does not specifically date this tree, so do not bridge to the earlier date.
